question.worked_solution:
First, we factor the numerator and denominator and cancel any common factors, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}f(t) & =\frac{{t}^{2}-5t+6}{3t-9} \\  & =\frac{(t-3)(t-2)}{3(t-3)} \\  & =\frac{\cancel{(t-3)}(t-2)}{3\cancel{(t-3)}} \\  & =\frac{(t-2)}{3}\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we set the numerator equal to zero and solve for $t:$

$$
\begin{aligned}t-2 & =0\,⟹\,t=2\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the solution to $f(t)=0$ is $t=2.$
